name: conditional-badge
title: Conditional warning badge
summary: A temperature reading from the host variable @temp that shows a red 'Too hot' badge only while @temp > 30, using conditionalOperations.
prompt: Show a temperature reading with a red "Too hot" badge that appears only when the temperature goes above 30 °C.
teaches: Draw commands only when a condition holds with conditionalOperations {condition gt, v1, v2, commands}
Compare a host variable against a constant threshold (@temp > 30)
Show the live value with textFromFloat(@temp, 2 whole digits, 1 decimal)

Fit a drawing authored at the header size to any box: a variable s = min(componentWidth() / W, componentHeight() / H), a translate by half the extra space and a scale by s about the design's centre; the background drawRect runs before it, to componentWidth() × componentHeight()
pitfalls: condition is one of gt, ge, lt, le, eq for the Java parser; ne is a json2rc extension, and Java silently reads an unknown condition as eq. There is no else branch: add a second conditionalOperations with the opposite test

textFromFloat `whole` is the number of integer digits kept, not a minimum: with whole 2 a reading of 104 shows as "04.0". Pick `whole` for the largest value you expect; the °C unit sits at a fixed x, so leave room for that width

Canvas coordinates are pixels of the box the host gives the document, not of the header: a background drawRect to the literal header size leaves the rest of a bigger box unpainted, and literal positions get cut off in a smaller one

snippets.note: conditionalOperations gt @temp 30: badge drawn only when it holds

check.describe: At temp 35 a red 'Too hot' pill shows beside 35.0 °C; at 20 (or the default 24) it is absent. Resized, the background fills the box and the drawing scales uniformly to fit, centred.
